body:
Authored schema management. ddl builds authored CREATE/ALTER/DROP statements and returns a Script of Statements carrying execution flags. schema.Set assembles declarations from independent owners and orders foreign-key dependencies. contrib/migrate offers Install, Execute and a checksum ledger in addition to Plan. The caller supplies schema changes and execution timing; this is not automatic inference of a live-schema diff.

Evidence: ds:block?id=ddl-contract-s2xdb9he; ds:block?id=schema-sort-wshjpc9c; ds:block?id=migration-install-ennvmeq2; ds:block?id=migration-execute-hgdykxdq; ds:block?id=migration-ledger-h5dv2yvb. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
